questions.question: God told Moses that an Israelite who slaughtered an ox, a lamb or a goat had to bring it where to offer it to the LORD?

answers.text: The entrance to the Tent of Meeting
The banks of the Jordan River

questions.question: To whom did God say the Israelites must no longer offer their sacrifices?
Why did God tell the Israelites not to eat blood?

answers.text: The life of the flesh is in the blood
The sickness of the flesh is in the blood
The curse of the ground is in the blood

questions.question: What did God say a person must do after eating an animal found dead or mauled by wild beasts?

answers.text: Wash his clothes and bathe with water
Offer a lamb at the altar
Stay outside the camp for a week
